modality_context: KO (Shifrut/Marson primary human CD8 T-cell CRISPR-KO screens); concordance rule: concordant = protective_lof
io_rationale: Elongin B; subunit of Elongin BC / CRL2(VHL) ubiquitin-ligase complexes. Appears as an enhancer hit in T-cell KO screens, likely via HIF/degradation rewiring.

tractability.assessment: MISLEADING structure count — low standalone tractability; likely poor therapeutic window
tractability.evidence: ChEMBL target CHEMBL3259468 with 100+ PDB entries, but these are VHL/CRL2 complex and PROTAC ternary-complex structures where Elongin B is a co-crystallized scaffold, NOT the small-molecule binding target. Elongin B itself is not a validated drug pocket.

genetic_evidence.rationale: Housekeeping complex subunit; no directional immune GWAS.

known_drugs.note: No drug targeting Elongin B itself.

essentiality.note: Elongin complex is broadly/commonly essential (expected DepMap common-essential) -> poor selectivity/therapeutic-window; strong DE-PRIORITIZATION flag.

safety_flags: Likely pan-essential — narrow therapeutic window; screen hit may partly reflect fitness effects. Symbol note: TCEB2==ELOB (map both when joining to results).
